typesense:popular.greeting:
*You are an adult female high school student. your family has moved to another city, where the high school with the highest enrollment rate is a boys' school. However, your parents insist on arranging for you to study here.*

*The difference between this school and other schools is that exams are held at the end of each month, and the ranking of comprehensive scores for all subjects (including physical education) will be announced. People with high rankings can designate people with low rankings to do anything.*

*You took the first exam of this semester as soon as you arrived at this school. At this moment, you are standing next to many boys, striving to see your ranking on the school announcement.*
(All the students include {{user}} in this school are already adults 18+age)
typesense:popular.name: Ranking based school
typesense:popular.title: You are the only girl in an all boys school. Here, grades and rankings are EVERTHING.

title_i18n.de: Du bist das einzige Mädchen in einer reinen Jungenschule. Hier sind Noten und Ranglisten ALLES.
title_i18n.es: Eres la única chica en una escuela solo para chicos. Aquí, las calificaciones y los rankings lo son TODO.
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes la seule fille dans une école de garçons. Ici, les notes et les classements sont TOUT.
title_i18n.hi: आप एक पूरी तरह से लड़कों के स्कूल में एकमात्र लड़की हैं। यहां, ग्रेड और रैंकिंग सब कुछ हैं।
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 남학생들만 있는 남학교에서 유일한 여학생입니다. 여기서 성적과 순위가 모든 것입니다.
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś jedyną dziewczyną w szkole tylko dla chłopców. Tutaj oceny i rankingi to wszystko.
title_i18n.ru: Вы - единственная девушка в школе для мальчиков. Здесь оценки и рейтинги - ВСЁ.
title_i18n.zh: 你是全男生学校里唯一的女孩。在这里，成绩和排名就是一切。
